# Git Workflow Instructions

- Inspect `git status`, the active branch, remotes, and relevant diffs before substantial work.
- Preserve user-owned changes and stage only files that belong to the requested change.
- The repository is `allenbenj/pages-main`; the deployment/default branch is `main`.
- Commit, push, rebase, merge, and force-push operations are maintainer-controlled. Do not perform them unless explicitly requested.
- Explain destructive consequences before proposing reset, clean, restore, rebase, or force-push operations.
- Review both the source diff and generated-file diff before handoff.
